editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: ThinkMarkets is a legitimate multi-regulated broker scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Eight regulatory licences — including FCA, ASIC, CySEC, DFSA, and JFSA — provide among the broadest geographical regulatory coverage in the market. The proprietary ThinkTrader app delivers the best mobile trading experience in this review series with built-in copy trading, advanced risk management, and a UI designed for 2026 rather than 2005. ThinkZero UK at $5 round-turn undercuts IC Markets and Pepperstone for British clients. And 1:2000 leverage on the Seychelles entity is the highest available from any broker reviewed. The limitation is platform lock-in: no TradingView, no cTrader. If you value the ThinkTrader ecosystem and mobile-first trading, this is a top-tier choice. If TradingView is your home, look elsewhere.
